name: mtg-scanner-desktop-runner
description: App de escritorio (Electron + NestJS + React/shadcn) para correr los pipelines de certamen_1 (pytorch/tensorFlow) sin usar la terminal manualmente.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,RENDERER -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:renderer"
